content.text: I'll plan it as three tasks and start with the index.

content.text:
The Swift index reads three sources: Claude Code transcripts, Codex rollouts and Antigravity titles. Ranking weighs a title match above a body match and a newer session above an older one.

I have the shape now, so the first task is done.
